_README.description: Model metadata for the local Ollama endpoint on the RX 7900 XTX, advertised by the Custom provider via CUSTOM_API_URL.
_README.usage: Each entry is advertised by the Custom provider. The Custom provider has exactly ONE base_url (providers/registry.py:108-117), so this file must describe whatever CUSTOM_API_URL points at. It currently points at http://localhost:11434/v1.
_README.provenance: Capability flags below are measured on this machine, not copied: context_window from /api/ps on a loaded model; supports_function_calling from the 'tools' capability in /api/show; supports_images and supports_extended_thinking from the absence of 'vision'/'thinking' there; supports_json_mode from a live response_format=json_object call that returned valid JSON; supports_temperature from a live generate at temperature=0.0 that returned. Measured 2026-08-27 against ollama 0.32.15.
_README.drift_hazard: This file is an assertion about a machine, and nothing checks it. If a model is removed (ollama rm), the entry advertises a model that 404s; if OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH is ever set, context_window below goes stale. Verify with: curl -s http://localhost:11434/v1/models. See decisions.md D-017.
_README.context_note: 32768 is what ollama 0.32.15 SERVES, not what these models were trained for (the 30b's trained maximum is 262144). It is a server default, not a model property, and it moves if OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH is set. Do not raise these numbers from a model card. Note also that context_window is the TOTAL budget shared by input and output: a caller must keep (input tokens + requested output tokens) <= 32768, so the effective prompt ceiling is 32768 minus whatever output it asks for. Exceeding it is rejected or truncated by the server, not by this file.
_README.history_note: This file previously described Mistral cloud models reached through CUSTOM_API_URL. D-008 repointed CUSTOM_API_URL at Ollama on 2026-08-26 without updating this file, which left every entry here resolving to a 404 for ~24h. Those entries are preserved in git commit 7448101. Restoring that lane needs a re-issued Mistral key AND the single Custom slot back; see decisions.md D-017. 2026-08-30: added served-context tags qwen3-coder:30b-48k and qwen3.8:27b-80k (D-031); intelligence_score kept in the deprioritized band per D-026 - opt-in-by-name, auto mode must not silently route here.
_README.policy_fields_not_measured: Two fields below are POLICY, not measurements, and must not be read as capability claims. max_output_tokens (8192) is a chosen cap, not a model limit. allow_code_generation is a permission this project grants, not something the Ollama API reports. intelligence_score (12/10) is deliberately low so auto-selection does not silently route other PAL consumers' traffic onto this machine's GPU; it is a routing policy value and NOT a judgement of model quality â€” see decisions.md D-010 for the actual measured performance.

models.description: Qwen3-Coder 30B-A3B on local Ollama (FREE, no network). Fastest model on this machine: 131.6 tok/s cold, 20.23 GiB resident, no CPU spill (decisions.md D-010). max_output_tokens is a conservative policy cap, not a measured limit.

Qwen2.5-Coder 14B on local Ollama (FREE, no network). The pinned unattended fallback tail (dispatcher shared.json:280, operator GO 2026-08-25). 62.9 tok/s, 14.24 GiB resident. max_output_tokens is a conservative policy cap, not a measured limit.

Qwen3-Coder 30B-A3B, 48K served-context tag (Modelfile num_ctx; takeover D-031: -c 49152 spawned, KV 4608 MiB, 21.74 GiB resident, no spill). Same weights as qwen3-coder:30b. context_window is the measured SERVED total (input+output budget).

Qwen3.8 27B, 80K served-context planner tag (takeover D-031/D-035 addendum: KV 5440 MiB @ 81920 cells, no spill; 96K does NOT fit - hybrid-recurrent buffer). 45.3 tok/s (D-010): planner, not workhorse. Model has thinking+vision capabilities but neither is measured through this /v1 path; flags stay false until they are (policy, not measurement).
